verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents key-only SSH authentication (password auth disabled) and standard SSH capabilities (secure login, remote command execution, file transfer) via docs-9, docs-36/43, giving developers direct SSH access with their own keys. However, the evidence pack never explicitly confirms root-level control within the instance environment, and some community feedback flags friction/reliability issues compared to major clouds (vast-ai-comm-7, vast-ai-comm-8), suggesting the SSH experience isn't always seamless. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of root/sudo privileges inside the instance, and independent hands-on confirmation of full root control.
